comment.body:
12 October 2026 — original government acquisition checkpoint.

Fixed XL: **233 catalogue-installed / 288 absent of 521**. Whole-map reporting: **346,108 source forms**, 4,516 enhanced forms and 6,649 native asset entries. Forms/assets are not unique physical buildings. These completed diagnostics add **zero installations**.

ROOT independently verified completed jobs on pinned Neon (billowing-surf-67227217 / br-icy-silence-b3wjwz0q / neondb), every literal evidence reference and released reservations:

- Upton actual-candidate clearance: job fbee12e07218f022deb4af6244a2487c6ce751da40fc5fe326c38c6bcef88a5e, all 8,283 references verified; pushed in 08f0e6f55. All 13,704 owned-source and 616 native projections passed complete coverage/ordinary-clearance checks in all four arithmetic bindings; no prior BASIC-clear regression. Raw diagnostic negatives remain preserved.
- Upton inherited overlap and finite boundaries: job 8afdd174bc4cbf629535df003ea134826b938657fdee7af4b0be390d8cd92dcb, all 8,305 references verified; pushed in 6df66aa3d. All 1,260 overlap projections are inherited from current terrain; 1,245 affine/MAX heights are exactly unchanged and 15 packing differences are at most 5.3873e-8 m. Finite-boundary diagnostics identify missing or degenerate nominated targets. Next work reconciles those targets against the full actual mesh without adding a global watertightness/exact-zero gate. The unchanged raw validator overlap rejection is preserved; this is not acceptance.
- West Wing existing contact graph: job fea35274bc537fa0c417a75bf63128fc688b125d5a5cd1a1713fa2f31ba76dbb, all 1,640 references verified; pushed in 0b6c39a27. Conditional genuine-contact reachability retains all source bodies and ordinary negatives; it does not supply a physical main-body root.
- West Wing fresh raw/owned identity: numerical checks finished; the initial freezer failed on a missing result uids field. Receipt-only recovery job c58f64cb891d9a23d20ddcee9d891cbd1c83219e483c60416522eec246039d3c is completed, all 785 references verified, pushed in f4101f0f5. Fresh identity fails with 83.3738% target coverage, 17.2976 m excess extent and 11.8497 m² foreign projected excess. Exact reasons are durable in Neon. No arithmetic replay, legacy acceptance backfill, corruption label or permanent source rejection.
- Southside private terrain preparation: actual 26 tests and current preflight pass. Construction stopped before any lease/decode because conservative whole-tile scope exceeded the unchanged 1,000-key reservation limit. An actual-production BASIC extent proof is now authorised to narrow only strictly disjoint actors, preserving all 1,238 scanned forms and all 46 protective resources. This orchestration failure is not model corruption. Construction awaits review of the actual narrowed scope.
- PolyU Sports Centre 305582: bounded unchanged-original component views and two official campus maps are being captured to investigate foreign projected excess. Schematic maps and projected-height context confer no identity, ownership or physical acceptance.

Previous completed source/terrain mathematics and negative findings remain reusable in the committed handoff. Full XL completion is unproven and these issues remain open. Original government geometry, 1× scale and placement stay unchanged; **zero AI geometry modelling**. The updated optimisation skill/framework is read; no optimisation jobs, variants, approval or publication have started.
